name: a new kind wears a hue no present kind wears, after the roadmap's kinds
a hue another present kind wears is refused where the kind is made
a hue only a deleted kind wore is free
a seventh kind is refused at the cap before anything is written
a kind label past 24 characters is refused
a change to a kind writes its changed words with the kind's life
a change to a kind writes its words alone: a hue it is given is a recolour's to write, so it writes the label and no hue
a change to a kind given a hue alone changes nothing and writes nothing
a change to a kind deleted elsewhere brings it back
a kind change that changes nothing writes nothing
a kind the roadmap never held is gone
recolouring a kind runs the command and predicts its hue and every step the device holds that wears it, present or not; one known only by its spent id the server recolours
recolouring a kind this device deleted itself and has not yet settled revives it first, then runs the command
recolouring a kind another device deleted, which this device knows only by its spent id, revives it first and predicts the kind's new hue alone
recolouring to a hue another present kind wears is refused
recolouring to the hue a kind wears writes nothing
a hue no kind may wear is refused
a kind moved below another is keyed between it and the next, with its life
a kind moved to the top is keyed before the first
a kind dropped where it stands writes nothing
deleting a kind writes its death
a kind the device no longer draws is not deleted again
